name: Netplay
description: Shared-screen netplay and link-cable play between two handhelds, over an ad hoc network the devices create themselves.
author: bmpriest

changelog.v2.0.0-test: Rewritten on a libretro shim - no patched system binaries. Ad hoc networking, core sharing between devices, bind-mounted pak wrapping, WiFi recovery. Adds my282, my355 and h700.
